subject: Dental appointment, round two
body:
holy shirt, you pulled a tooth out of a Kraken. Big Bertha's blade needs one and the Mysterious Locket wants one too for the Space Stone, so your going back for a second. That poor thing didnt even get a lollipop after the first one.

P.S. ask if its been flossing. dentists love asking that while their whole arm is in your mouth
